To be reminded that there's only five/six true area and the last goes up to 165k momentum is insane. If we are to see the entire story (reminder that we're still early in their story), that would mean we'd get up to a million momentum at that point. They need to revisit momentum properly, perhaps set the required amounts lower and change up bosses not to be beasts of momentum but threats thanks to their skills and combos. Force the player not to overpower the bosses not by outscaling their momentum but by playing smarter than the ai. 

Lastly we need more story implications. I'm not asking for more released content more frequently but to let our character participate to major events to solidify their presence to canon characters. We don't need to cling to Jon's shadow or every step but imagine living the battle of the Wall, just along the rest of the Watch in the thick of the fight. If I could change or add one major system to Kingsroad, it would be meaningful endgame progression and world reactivity—giving F2P grinders, high-momentum players, and alliances real in-world recognition and things to do beyond repetitive dungeons and seasonal events.

​Here is how that could work:
​High-Risk, High-Reward Hidden Quests (F2P Cosmetics): Right now, weapon skins and outfits are locked behind purchases. Once players hit high milestones (Level 55+ or specific Momentum thresholds), tough, hidden side quests should unlock. Completing them could let players pick 1 of 3 exclusive rare weapon skins or outfits. They don't need flashy animations—clean, grounded upgrades like unique sword hilts, custom blade designs, or jeweled accents would look amazing and reward heavy grinding.

​Dynamic NPC & World Reactivity: Once we finish major story arcs, the world shouldn't feel frozen. For example, after uncovering the poison plot in Hightower and the Reach, returning to those areas should trigger updated NPC dialogue—townsfolk praising our work, reacting to our choices, and making the world feel alive.

​In-World Prestige for Top Leaderboard Players: Making the Seasonal Hall of Fame (Top 5) or Greatsword (Top 30) shouldn't just be a name on a menu. High-momentum lords should feel their status in the open world—NPCs, guards, and rival lords should react to their presence with awe, fear, respect, or even jealousy and hostility.

​True Alliance-vs-Alliance Field Wars: Alliance content is currently too limited to dungeons and exchange shops. This is Game of Thrones—we need large-scale Alliance-vs-Alliance open-field wars scaled by world difficulty and player momentum.

If I could change ONE thing about **Game of Thrones: Kingsroad**, it would be to make Westeros feel more alive, immersive, and truly open-world.

The world of Westeros has so much potential, and I would love to see more meaningful exploration, dynamic world events, and activities that give players a reason to keep coming back even after completing the main story.

Imagine random encounters while travelling, large-scale battles between different Houses, territory conflicts, castle sieges, dragon-related events, and world bosses that require players to work together. It would be incredible to see players actively shape what happens across Westeros rather than simply following quests.

And one feature I would absolutely love is **more dragon-focused content**. Dragons are one of the most iconic parts of Game of Thrones. Giving players more opportunities to encounter, experience, and interact with these legendary creatures would make the adventure even more memorable.

I genuinely believe Kingsroad has the foundation to become something special. The world, atmosphere, combat, and Game of Thrones universe are already there. Now it's about giving players more reasons to explore, fight, cooperate, and build their own stories.

**Don't just let us visit Westeros. Give us the freedom to live in it, create memories in it, and become part of its history.**

Looking forward to seeing how the developers take Kingsroad forward. Keep building, keep listening to the community, and let's make Westeros even greater! ❤️     

— A passionate Kingsroad player & content creator  
YouTube: **Dathronix_is_Live** ❤️

I don't just play Kingsroad; I want to see this world grow and become something unforgettable for its community.
